test_title: General intelligence and Reasoning Ability Mock Test 28

questions.question: In a certain code language,'A + B' means ‘A is the mother of B’,'A – B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,'A × B' means ‘A is the wife of B’,'A % B' means ‘A is the father of B’, and'A # B' means ‘A is the daughter of B’.How is K related to P if ‘P + G # Z % N + K # T’?

Below are given two sets of numbers. In each set of numbers, a certain mathematical operation on the first number results in the second number. Similarly, certain mathematical operation on the second number results in the third number and so on. Which of the given options follows the same set of operations as in the question?(Note: A two-/three-digit number cannot be broken into individual digits for operations e.g., if 37 is followed by 10, the operation cannot be 3 + 7 as a two-digit number cannot be broken into individual digits.) 20 - 32 - 256 - 2662 - 14 - 112 - 122
In a certain code language, ‘TOUR’ is coded as ‘8745’ and ‘OURS’ is coded as ‘4567’. What is the code for ‘S’ in the given code language?
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order? DBY  BZW  ZXU  XVS  ?
In an exhibition, Pranav is standing to the west of Bony, who is standing to the south of Mohit. In which direction is Pranav standing with respect to Mohit?
If + means –, – means ×, × means ÷, and ÷ means +, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?10 – 154 × 11 + 116 ÷ 36 = ?
Raju ranked 61st from the bottom and 11th from the top in his class. How many students are there in his class?
If ‘A’ stands for ‘+’, ‘B’ stands for ‘−’, ‘C’ stands for ‘×’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘÷’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?4 A 6 C 3 B 12 D 2 = ?

Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Marc is an immediate neighbour of both Rian and Nick. Olive is sitting to the immediate right of Rian. Quinn is sitting second to the left of Marc. Patty is an immediate neighbour of both Quinn and Olive. How many people sit between Patty and Marc when counted from the right of Marc?

Seven boxes, C, D, E, F, G, H and Y, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept above F. Only one box is kept between G and C, where G is kept above C. Only three boxes are kept between Y and H. Only E is kept below H. G is kept at one of the places above Y. How many boxes are kept between D and G?

In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.DIVE - VDIE - EVIDCOLD - LCOD - DLOC
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (PLAY - APLY - YALP) है।

questions.question: Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets. (Note: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)  6 - 2 - 244 - 6 - 48
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?13   23   33   43   53   ?

This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.(Left)       549       671       518       426       471       (Right)(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)(Note: All operations to be done from left to right.)What will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is added to the second digit of the second lowest number?

Select the triad that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

NK-PM-RT
RO-TQ-VX

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:Some pianos are guitars.All guitars are violins.No violins are drums.Conclusions:I: Some pianos are violins.II: No guitars are drums.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow) है।

questions.question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F sits third to the right of C. E sits second to the left of C. B sits third to the right of D. A sits to the immediate left of B.How many people sit between A and E when counted from the left of A?

This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.(Left)       493       672       815       264       357       (Right)(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)(Note: All operations to be done from left to right.)What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is multiplied with the third digit of the second lowest number?
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order? MIN  RNS  WSX  BXC  ?

Mohan started walking from Point A, towards south. He walked for 4 m and turned left. He walked for 3 m and turned left again. He walked for 2 m and turned left again. He walked for 5 m. Once again, he turned left and walked for 4 m. Again, he turned left and walked for 7 m. Lastly, he turned left again and walked for 6 m before stopping at point B.How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he walk in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (5 m towards west) है।
